description: This file contains the implementation of the Order class in the Opencart system, specifically within the API sale controller namespace. It includes methods for loading, saving, commenting, confirming orders, and handling related order operations such as processing request data, validating order details, updating sessions, and interfacing with order models.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: The Order class handles API-related operations for sale orders in the OpenCart platform, including loading order data, saving updates, adding comments, and confirming order status through various API endpoints.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: The Order class handles API-related operations for sale orders in the OpenCart platform, including loading order data, saving updates, adding comments, confirming order status, deleting orders, and managing order history.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads order information based on 'order_id' from the request, retrieves customer, payment, shipping, product, voucher, and order total details, then populates the session data accordingly.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates order data, including validation of request post data, order editing, and responding with success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to the order after validating the 'comment' field from POST request, updating session data, and returning status via JSON response.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Performs validation checks such as cart stock, product minimum quantities, customer authentication, payment and shipping address validity, and finalizes the order confirmation process with JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple orders based on 'order_id's provided in POST or GET requests, returning the operation status.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for an order, including status change, comment, and notification preferences, then responds with success status.
